findings.reason: the node can close the section on a difference inside the pass bar, so the control should be stated as the per-session arm missing the 1% bar, which the fragment already records at 2.4%.
findings.text: §9's control arm is only "the per-session reserve delivers a lower rate than the lane-wide reserve does" while the pass bar is within 1% of the single-session rate, so a per-session arm 0.5% short would satisfy both the pass criterion and the control even though the deliverable's measured justification is a 2.4% shortfall against the lane-wide rule's 0.1%
